name: Pages that render and work
note: What opening the page in a real browser, at the base and at the head, can measure in 12 combinations (desktop and phone, light and dark, as loaded, mirrored right to left and with Arabic text), and how fast it loads and what it calls.

rules.name: A physical side is used where the layout may need to mirror
Things overlap
rules.bad: two boxes share the same pixels
rules.good: room for both, in both directions

rules.name: Text is cut off
rules.bad: width: 148px on a button that holds text

rules.name: The page shows nothing
rules.good: the content, or a message that says why not

rules.name: The page throws an uncaught error
rules.bad: TypeError: undefined is not a function

rules.name: A request from the page fails
rules.good: every request the page makes succeeds

rules.name: The page logs a new warning
An id is used more than once
rules.good: one element per id, so a label or an aria reference finds the right one

rules.name: The page calls the same thing more often
rules.good: each call once, or a reason for more

rules.name: Text that isn't in the translation files
rules.bad: <button>Place order</button> in a project with locales/

rules.name: The page loads clearly more script
rules.good: about as much as before, or a reason for more
